finding: Transformer activation memory increases approximately linearly with batch size.
evidence: Estimated activation memory rises nearly proportionally as batch size increases.
why_it_matters: Larger batches improve throughput but require proportionally more GPU memory.

finding: Transformer activation memory increases much faster with sequence length.
why_it_matters: Long-context inference becomes memory intensive much faster than CNN inference.
Sequence length is usually the largest driver of Transformer inference memory.

finding: Transformer memory scaling differs fundamentally from CNN scaling.
evidence: CNN depends mainly on image resolution while Transformer depends on sequence length.
Analytical estimates and CUDA profiling were generated across multiple sequence lengths and batch sizes.
why_it_matters: Provides the Transformer counterpart to the CNN scaling study from Day 57.
